newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end up, players take profits on CVRD.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end up, players take profits on CVRD.

text.p: Brazilian stocks lost some ground late in the session, influenced by volatility on Wall Street, but still ended higher Wednesday on buy orders for blue-chips and some second-tier stocks, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 49 most active shares rose 0.85 percent to 81,712 points. Market turnover was a high 591.9 million reais ($565.4 million).
Contrary to some traders' expectations, the bolsa was firm most of the day, with top blue-chips posting further gains.
An exception was state mining conglomerate Companhia Vale
Investors took profits on the stock after local wire reports said a privatization base price for the company could not be set at today's meeting of the National Privatization Council (CND).
Vale do Rio Doce preferred had been surging on speculation that the council would give details on the firm's bid specifications, including the company's minimum price.
